newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: P.Telecom not taking stake in Concert.
newsitem.headline: P.Telecom not taking stake in Concert.

text.p: Portugal Telecom (PT) will not take a stake in either the U.S. MCI Communications Corp or British Telecommunications Plc (BT) after linking up with their Concert alliance, Portugal's Planning Minister Joao Cravinho said.

Portugal Telecom said on Monday that it had chosen the Anglo-U.S. venture as its strategic ally. As part of the deal, British Telecom will take a one percent holding in the Portuguese concern with MCI taking half a percent.
"It was agreed with MCI and BT that a share exchange would not be necessary. It was enough for them to take a symbol stake in PT," the minister told a news conference to announce the accord.
Neither British Telecom nor MCI now hold shares in Portugal Telecom.
